title: Grade 7 French — Tue, Jun 10
description: Le passé composé — Day 2 of 5: Regular -ER verbs
subject: french

questions.question: How do you form the past participle of a regular -ER verb?
questions.explanation: Regular -ER past participle: remove -ER, add -É. Parler → parlé. Manger → mangé.

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'danser' (to dance)?
questions.explanation: Danser → dansé. 'J'ai dansé toute la nuit.' = I danced all night.

questions.question: Translate: 'He cooked.' (cuisiner = to cook)
questions.explanation: 'Il a cuisiné.' = He cooked. Cuisiner → cuisiné. Passé composé: il + a + cuisiné.

questions.question: What is 'Nous avons regardé la télé' in English?
options: We watched TV / We have watched TV
questions.explanation: 'Nous avons regardé la télé.' = We watched TV / We have watched TV. Passé composé.

questions.question: Conjugate 'travailler' (to work) in passé composé for 'vous':
questions.explanation: 'Vous avez travaillé.' = You (pl./formal) worked. Vous + avez + travaillé.

questions.question: Translate: 'They (ils) played football yesterday.'
options: Ils ont joué au football hier.
Ils vont jouer au football hier.
questions.explanation: 'Ils ont joué au football hier.' = They played football yesterday. Jouer → joué. Hier = yesterday.

questions.question: What is the past participle of 'chanter' (to sing)?
questions.explanation: Chanter → chanté. 'Elle a chanté une belle chanson.' = She sang a beautiful song.

questions.question: Choose the correct passé composé: 'I bought bread.' (acheter = to buy)
questions.explanation: 'J'ai acheté du pain.' = I bought bread. Acheter → acheté.

questions.question: Translate: 'We visited the museum last week.' (visiter = to visit)
options: Nous visitons le musée la semaine dernière.
Nous avons visité le musée la semaine dernière.
Nous visiterons le musée la semaine prochaine.
questions.explanation: 'Nous avons visité le musée la semaine dernière.' = We visited the museum last week.

questions.question: Identify the passé composé: which sentence is WRONG?
options: Il a dansé toute la nuit.
questions.explanation: 'Elle a joue au tennis.' is wrong. Past participle of 'jouer' = 'joué' (with accent). Correct: 'Elle a joué au tennis.'

questions.question: Complete the story: 'Hier, je ___ (se lever) tôt, je ___ (manger) le petit-déjeuner...' [focus on manger only]
questions.explanation: 'J'ai mangé le petit-déjeuner.' — passé composé for a completed action yesterday.

questions.question: Translate: 'She called her friend.' (appeler = to call)
questions.explanation: 'Elle a appelé son amie.' = She called her friend. Appeler → appelé.

questions.question: What time words often go with the passé composé?
options: Hier, la semaine dernière, ce matin (yesterday, last week, this morning)
Demain, la semaine prochaine (tomorrow, next week)
Maintenant, en ce moment (now, at the moment)
questions.explanation: Passé composé = completed past action. Time markers: hier (yesterday), ce matin (this morning), la semaine dernière (last week), l'année dernière (last year).

questions.question: Conjugate 'écouter' (to listen) in passé composé — all 6 forms:
options: j'ai écouté, tu as écouté, il a écouté, nous avons écouté, vous avez écouté, ils ont écouté — correct
j'ai écouté, tu a écouté, il as écouté...
questions.explanation: Passé composé of écouter: j'ai écouté, tu as écouté, il a écouté, nous avons écouté, vous avez écouté, ils ont écouté.

questions.question: Translate: 'Yesterday, you (tu) washed the car.' (laver = to wash)
options: Hier, tu as lavé la voiture.
questions.explanation: 'Hier, tu as lavé la voiture.' = Yesterday, you washed the car. Laver → lavé.
